messages:
jessica_user: Hey support — trying to apply a trial coupon (CODE: TRY-REDWOOD-50) on my org account but it keeps saying 'invalid/expired'. I think it's valid? created it from the marketing email yesterday.

sam_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact code and your org email? also any screenshot of the error helps.

jessica_user: sure: TRY-REDWOOD-50 (all caps). org email: jessica@acme-studio.com. Screenshot: shows banner 'Coupon invalid or expired' after clicking Apply. No errors in the browser console.

sam_support: Thanks. I ran a quick check on the promo DB and the code exists and is active (starts: 2026-03-01, expires: 2026-09-01, amount: $50 credit).

billing-bot: [automated log] promo-check: code=TRY-REDWOOD-50 status=ACTIVE allocations=1 max_allocations=100 eligibility=ORG_RULE_VIOLATION

mike_billing: @sam_support digging into the redemption logs for jessica@acme-studio.com — the validation path returned error code `PROMO_INELIGIBLE` with message 'org already has trial credit applied'. UI surface incorrectly maps that to the generic 'invalid/expired' string.

jessica_user: That makes sense? We don't remember applying a trial earlier. Could it be from a teammate?

lisa_engineer: quick repro steps I used: 1) create a new org; 2) POST /v1/promos/redeem {code: TRY-REDWOOD-50, org_id: 0xabc} -> returns 400 {"error":"PROMO_INELIGIBLE","detail":"org has existing trial credit"}. UI frontend maps any non-200 to "invalid/expired".

mike_billing: Root cause: backend is rejecting because the org had a legacy 'intro credit' flag toggled during an invoice migration in Jan. The promo system treats that flag as an existing trial allocation. UX maps PROMO_INELIGIBLE to 'invalid/expired' which is misleading.

sam_support: For now I've issued a manual $50 credit to jessica@acme-studio.com and cleared the legacy flag on your org so you can redeem in the future. You should see the credit in Billing > Credits (refresh may take a minute).

jessica_user: Thanks! I see the $50 credit now :thumbsup: Appreciate the quick help.

mike_billing: Filed a bug/incident: INC-1234 to fix frontend error mapping and INC-1235 to adjust migration scripts to not mark migrated accounts as 'intro credit' unless truly used. We'll follow up in #incidents when patches roll out.

sam_support: Closing the thread. If anything else pops up ping @support.
